items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: In the meantime, at the Club Plantation, they were bringing in different acts -- Ella Fitzgerald, different ones.

ctx.x: New black spot. And it was hot as fire there. I mean, that is, packed and jammed. We opened there with a big floor show. And the people fell in love with the Club Riviera. Opening night, the streets were just -- the whole entire block was just -- the policemen had to block the entire thing off. People were just lined up, trying to get in. Couldn't serve all the people.

In the meantime, at the Club Plantation, they were bringing in different acts -- Ella Fitzgerald, different ones. So finally, they just went broke paying those big prices. And those big acts, like Ella Fitzgerald. I mentioned Cab. I mentioned the Mills Brothers.
Because -- I said Benny Carter was in there, because there was some kind of (unintelligible) wasn't there?
